import json,sys,urllib.request,urllib.parse,re
sys.path.insert(0,'/root/direct-sync')
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("s","/root/direct-sync/expeditor_direct_sync.py")
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.argv=["x"]; spec.loader.exec_module(m)
deals=[d for d in json.load(open("/root/direct-sync/deals_raw.json")) if d.get("Posted")]
rows=m.nc_records(["Id","Угода","BL","Контейнер","ETA","Клієнт","Статус"])
by={m.num(r.get("Угода")):r for r in rows}
def cmp(col,fld,conv):
    empty=diff=[];empty=0;diff=[]
    for d in deals:
        n=m.num(d.get("Number")); cur=by.get(n)
        if not cur: continue
        new=conv(d.get(fld))
        if not new: continue
        old=cur.get(col) or ""
        old=str(old)[:10] if col=="ETA" else str(old)
        if not old: empty+=1
        elif old!=str(new): diff.append((n,old,str(new)))
    print("== %s ← %s: порожніх заповнимо %d, РІЗНІ %d"%(col,fld,empty,len(diff)))
    for t in diff[:12]: print("   угода %s: %s  ->  %s"%t)
cmp("ETA","ЕТА",m.d10); cmp("BL","Коносамент",m.txt); cmp("Контейнер","СписокКонтейнеров",m.containers)
cmp("Клієнт","Клиент_Key",lambda g: m.ref(json.load(open('/root/direct-sync/names.json')),'client',g))
EOF
